scientific_integrity: A complete all-k proof and independently implemented finite check are provided. Finite checks do not substitute for the proof; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes the binary no-adjacent-ones maximal-entropy stationary source, width exactly three k-mers, lexicographic order and leftmost tie-breaking; it asserts neither other-source predictions nor optimality. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Exact lexicographic minimizer density and two-step plateaus on the golden-mean source
